notes.title: Balance hotfix: Lotara Sarrin
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/14fd508b214e60b8b61916164ddb79f3f932f6d7.jpg
"This is New Kershal all over again. Disengage!"
– Lotara Sarrin

Lotara returned to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy in force, and her initial performance sounded all of the alarms. Even though we have seen in the past how new cards and Warlords have achieved higher-than-average win rates while the meta reacts and players learn how to counter the new challengers, Lotara became a force to be reckoned with. This created a frustrating ladder to take part in, and a repetitive and tiresome competitive environment.

For this reason, today we are releasing an emergency balance hotfix addressing the situation and tweaking the main offenders of Lotara's ranked dominance:

IMPERIAL ARMY
● Lotara Sarrin: Changed Savage ability to 'Give Flank to adjacent troops' (it no longer buffs adjacent troops)

MECHANICUM
● Glaividian Ursarax: Increased ability cost from 0 to 1 and changed ability to '(1) Stun a random enemy troop' (instead of a random enemy).

These changes are now live in the game. We will continue to monitor the situation, as well as monitor the rest of the meta in preparation for the next balance update, currently scheduled for the first full week of the next competitive season.

notes.title: Incoming changes to Legacy Mode
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/89da85fb0252231946cfbca19065ff3bc1dab8f7.jpg
Greetings, players!

Following up on the last update's changes, we will soon make some additions and tweaks to Legacy Mode. After reading the feedback received from the release of the last expansion, we will be taking some measures to improve the game mode.

Firstly, in the same manner as Standard Mode, Legacy Mode will count with a Ranked / Unranked toggle. To avoid splitting the player base, players on both Ranked and Unranked will sometimes be matched against one another, but they will only earn or lose ranked points if they entered the battle with the Ranked toggle activated.

At the end of the Season, Legacy Rating will also start acting like in Standard Mode. Players above 2500 Legacy rating will be reset to 2500 rating, and the difference will be added to a new tally of Legendary points.

In this first season change after the update, all players who have a lower ranking on Legacy than Standard will see their Legacy rating raised to match their Standard rating. This is a one-off adjustment. Going forward, the ratings on Standard and Legacy may diverge and won't be adjusted again each season (other than to bring them down to 2500 rating as usual).

These changes will be making their way into the game in a future update.

notes.title: Galaxy in Flames: Wave IV release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/200f2af6079fb1f526b80fa7b16ead8b537f53a7.jpg
"How do you rank in the chain of command?"
– Saul Niborran

While the bloodiest of fighting was done by the Legiones Astartes, the bulk of the war was waged by the Imperial Army, Mechanicum and traitor elements. Millions fought against once comrades, while allied forge worlds tore each other apart, and Chaos cults sprung up on hundreds of loyalist worlds. 

Take a look at how to collect the cards from the fourth wave and at the new event in the latest blog post.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/eeede1a491daf3c32e5f9e1499012261d4be4e5d.jpg

NEW CARDS FOR THE NEUTRAL FACTIONS
For the more human elements of the loyalist and traitor forces, the war continued as it ever did. Countless Imperial Army contingents were sent to numerous warzones to fight for either Horus or the Emperor. The Mechanicum was decisively split in twain, with half following the original teachings of the Omnissiah and staying loyal to the Emperor and new Fabricator-General, while the other half turned to embrace the warp and techno-heresy, employing forbidden sciences to bolster their forces. Chaos cults and daemons manifested with more liberty than ever before, as where discord and ruin went, the forces of the Archenemy were never too far behind.

Twenty new cards are added for the neutral factions to bolster either their own decks or be added to Legions as a way of supporting the Astartes’ own wars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/74cd4b003218189176e554fe095f14612ecf83f9.jpg

HOW TO COLLECT THE NEW CARDS
Complement your deck and complete your collection with the new cards from the fourth wave. There are multiple ways to collect them:

Galaxy in Flames crates in the shop have 5 cards from the expansion, with at least 1 being rare or better.
A constructed deck in the shop, with Thaddeus Fayle as warlord and the new Sork legendary card. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop and Veteran Shop.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1b5dc1ac98d6e3a0d89e70d52b374d84effebc0c.jpg

NEW EVENT: ‘SAFEGUARDING ETERNITY’
The traitors advance towards the Eternity Gate Spaceport. Hosts of World Eaters charge, imbued by Khorne’s bloodthirst, as Terra’s defenders prepare to make their last stand before them. The Eternity Wall must not fall!

Test the new neutral cards for the first time in the new event, Safeguarding Eternity. Will you join the carnage as the traitor invaders or as the loyalists in the wall’s forlorn defence?

GALAXY IN FLAMES EXPANSION CRATES ARE NOW AVAILABLE. COMPLETE YOUR DECK’S STRATEGIES AND DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD WITH THE NEW CARDS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/5e08839593d4c052da6729633dcbca4fc560f6d8.jpg

"Borrowed power is no power at all."
– Lord Cypher

Balance changes! With the release of the Galaxy in Flames expansion in full swing, the meta is shifting and all Legions are looking to find their place on the rapidly evolving battlefield. Nevertheless, November also brings a few balance changes to restrain a few decks which were becoming overly dominant in ranked play.

Jangsai Khan also receives a nerf to limit his growing supremacy in the current timed event, though it will not affect players who are in the middle of an event run with him.

Check out the details:

Sons of Horus
Sarpati Squad: Change bonus when playing a Chaos card from +1/+1 to +1/0

Emperor's Children
Hold at All Costs: When played with Perfection, refill only 5 Energy (instead of all Energy)

Defenders Of Caliban
Pride of Caliban: Change ability to allow warlord to act only once more each time, rather than twice if it has Blood Thirst

Ultramarines
Captain Alcaeus: Change ability so that it triggers on Courage, rather than being activated

Event balance change
Jangsai Khan receives a nerf to limit his growing supremacy in the current timed event, and will no longer refill Energy every time you activate Streak.

Players in the middle of an event run with Jangsai Khan will not be impacted by this change, but all new event runs started after the patch will only be able to choose the new version of Jangsai Khan.

Stay tuned to the blog to know all about the game.

notes.title: Balance changes - June 2021

"We remain vigilant, this doesn't end here."

A well-planned strike can make an arduous battle short, as the new factions have demonstrated, but no warrior can ever rely on the same ruse working twice. When your enemy adapts to your strategies, it's time to think of another plan to shock their defences.

A new balance patch has been released, with adjustments to two recently released cards (Jenetia Krole and Euphrati Keeler) which were having a disproportionate impact in constructed play. The card Desperate Defence has also been reviewed, to cap its potential after a long period influencing the top tiers of ranked play. Additionally, Malcador and a few rarely used cards receive some buffs.

Check out the details in the blog post.

Update v1.4.4 is out with some major improvements to how decks can be shared! You can now share them in the Lodge and Global chats, or copy them to your clipboard and share them anywhere, in a readable text format that can be automatically imported by other players.

How to share a deck:
1) In Cards, click the eye icon next to the deck's name to open the full-deck view.
2) The 'share' button on the top right corner offers three options: share to Lodge, to Global chat, or to clipboard.
3) Once copied to clipboard, you can paste the deck in a readable text format anywhere you like.
4) To import a deck, go to Cards -> Change deck, click on the notepad icon and paste the text.
5) You need to own the warlord to import a deck. Any cards not owned will be highlighted and need to be replaced.

Will you share your battle wisdom, or keep the secret to yourself?

notes.title: Prospero update - release notes
notes.notes:
The Prospero expansion is about to begin, and it brings more than just new cards. Take a look at the new features and improvements included in the latest update, available to download now:

Share Match Replays and Decks with your Lodge
A much requested feature is finally here! Use the new 'Share' button in the Battle Log to share replays in your Lodge chat.
In addition, you can now share decks with your Lodge, either to show your deck-building skills or to ask for advice. Use the eye icon from the Deck editing menu to see your full deck, and then the new 'share' button to send it to your Lodge chat. Please note that, if you make further changes to the deck after sharing it, other Lodge members who press the link will see the most up to date version.

Improved Collection View
See which cards you own from each faction in a single view in your Collection, to make it easier to take a screenshot and share it when asking for deck-building advice. From your Collection, press the new list icon at the top right of the screen to activate this view.

Warlord Chats in Collection
You can now listen to all Warlord chats from the Collection. Go to any Warlord and find the chat icon to listen to their 6 combat chats, even if you haven't collected them all yet.

Improved Match Replays Controls
Review your match replays with improved controls: 
-> 'Pause' will now stop any actions queued from pressing the 'Next' button.
-> Advancing with 'Next' will now speed up some animations to move forward faster.

Support for 4:3 screen ratio 
The game now supports an increased range of screen formats, in full screen or windowed mode, up to 4:3 screen ratio.
